title: Planet Tweaks V3.0.2 NOVA TITAN - Pro Drag Edit FPS Frame-Sync, Shotgun Prefire and Sprint Editing Engine
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.0.2 NOVA TITAN: (1) One-Button Pro Drag Edit Overhaul: Freely assignable Tile Select key (zero forced bindings) with 4-way calibrated FPS Frame-Sync (360 FPS / 240 FPS / GFN 165 FPS Synced / 144 FPS) delivering true 0.00ms Confirm on Release. (2) Competitive Shotgun Prefire Defense: 1-Tap Pump Shotgun + Instant Wall cover (< 20ms) to eliminate return fire and trade damage. (3) Sprint Editing Engine: Automatically maintains Tactical Sprint lock through edits for zero momentum drop during high-speed piece control. (4) Zen Mantle Upgrade: High-frequency mantle pulse (22ms down, 14ms up) with continuous W forward pin for effortless first-frame ledge mantling.
